title: ₹18.4 lakh 'digital arrest', 8 accounts frozen
summary: A retired professor's ₹18.4 lakh fans out across 4 banks in 40 minutes; LienLine liens each account's traceable share and releases a freelancer paid for real work.

complaint.narrative: Callers posing as CBI officers kept me on a video call from 8 am, said my Aadhaar was used in a money-laundering case and I was under 'digital arrest'. They made me transfer my savings to an 'RBI safe account' XXXX8683 at Sahyadri Bank: Rs 12,00,000 by RTGS at 10:00 (UTR 626584570777) and Rs 6,40,000 at 10:24 (UTR 626138738782). Total Rs 18,40,000.

grievances.text: I am a graphic designer. Arjun Nair paid me ₹12,000 for a logo. My whole account is frozen and I cannot pay rent.

reasons.text: The victim's money arrived via T1 (₹12,00,000.00 of ₹12,00,000.00 from A1), T2 (₹6,40,000.00 of ₹6,40,000.00 from A1). The balance fell to ₹16,500.00 after T11, which caps what can still be traced: ₹16,500.00 under LIBR (lowest intermediate balance).

This letter serves as an instruction regarding the hold placed on account XXXX8683, held by Yadav Traders (Rahul Yadav) at your branch. This action follows the NCRP acknowledgement 31509260054321 and the notice under Section 106 BNSS dated 03 Sep 2026 from Insp. K. Thakur, State Cyber Cell, Jabalpur.

The current hold is ₹16,500.00 (the whole balance). We note credits received via UTR 626584570777 (₹12,00,000.00) and UTR 626138738782 (₹6,40,000.00), both of which have traceable amounts under LIBR.

In accordance with the legal precedents set by MP High Court, Archana v State of MP, 27 Jul 2026, and Rajasthan High Court, Shree Balaji Enterprises v RBI, 20 Aug 2026, a hold must be limited to the identifiable disputed amount. Therefore, you are instructed to replace the whole-account freeze with a lien of ₹16,500.00, which is the amount traceable under the lowest intermediate balance rule. Nodal Officer, Sahyadri Bank

letters.subject: Justification for Full Balance Freeze on Account XXXX8008 due to Cyber Fraud Complaint
letters.body:
This letter serves to justify the decision to maintain a full freeze on the balance of ₹10,500.00 in Account XXXX8008, held by Deepak Solanki.

This action is taken following the NCRP acknowledgement 31509260054321 and the notice under Section 106 BNSS dated 03 Sep 2026 from Insp. K. Thakur, State Cyber Cell, Jabalpur. The current hold is ₹10,500.00, which is traceable to this complaint alone under LIBR.

Given the high risk indicators, the full freeze of ₹10,500.00 is necessary.

Nodal Officer, Vindhya Gramin Bank

The hold has been lifted. Please contact us if you require further clarification.

Nodal Officer, Narmada Bank
